ID.title: Managed asset identity
ID.source_interpretation: A factory product type identifies plug-in type. A managed asset has a UUID and a changeable name. A subordinate sensor ID is scoped to the asset. None is sufficient evidence of a serial number.

MED.title: Consumer interface and plug-in
MED.source_interpretation: Asset is the consumer interface. AssetProxy implements custom interactions. A managed asset may represent equipment with several sensors.

LIFE.title: Discovery, activation and availability
LIFE.source_interpretation: Discovery proposes found assets and the directory manages instances. Asynchronous activation has transitional and failure states. Capture or command behavior while inactive is plug-in dependent.

CAP.title: Product capabilities
CAP.source_interpretation: A factory publishes capabilities for a product. Optional supported fields and ranges describe what may be supplied. A declared ability does not report its current value.

ATTR.title: Core and plug-in attribution
ATTR.source_interpretation: On the asset persist path the core supplies controller ID, store version, test-mode flag and managed asset identity. It creates observation UUID and creation time when missing. Spatial overrides depend on configuration and sensor key. Merge bypasses enrichment.

OBS.title: Observation identity, subject, value and time
OBS.source_interpretation: The observation envelope separates record UUID, asset UUID, controller ID, optional sensor ID, observed time and creation time. It can relate observations and carry a typed result.

CMD.title: Commands, responses and unsolicited updates
CMD.source_interpretation: Command and response structures may identify a sensor. The response-update event may describe a change without a preceding command.

STATUS.title: Reported condition
STATUS.source_interpretation: Status supports a summary, component conditions, run time, battery and temperature. The capability flags for providing these fields have a different subject.

ENV.title: Environmental observations
ENV.source_interpretation: Weather has explicit atmospheric, surface and water fields. WaterQuality defines separately typed sample quantities. A common scalar representation does not make different phenomena equivalent.

POWER.title: Power observations
POWER.source_interpretation: A declared source, measurement window, aggregate and load quantities have separate roles. Nominal limits are separate from observed values.

MEDIA.title: Recorded media and supporting measurements
MEDIA.source_interpretation: Image, video, audio and channel metadata describe the captured material, timing or format. Capability ranges alone cannot establish recorded media.

STORE.title: Storage and retrieval
STORE.source_interpretation: Persistence, merge and query serve distinct purposes. Query filters identify the subject or time range of stored records.

SPECIAL.title: Specialized observation and command families
SPECIAL.source_interpretation: Specialized schemas were indexed. Comparisons are bounded to descriptive meanings and source standing. Evidence for unexamined details remains open.

holds.OSUS-Q1: Selected implementation and schema depth. Inventory does not prove every method, dependency, field constraint or extension was independently audited.
holds.OSUS-Q2: Guide and thesis are companions. External protocols, deployments and other plug-ins require their own evidence.
holds.OSUS-Q3: No live equipment tests. Physical identity, wiring, deployed plug-in, successful operations and actual data attribution require case records.
